_what: How each kind of notification looks: an icon name (Lucide, either casing), and a tone. A kind with `gate_words` passes its title and detail through the one failure-words gate (parts/ui/show/safe-error-card sanitize-error-text): words written for a program or an AI, an id or a reference are replaced by the row's `title`, and a detail that cannot pass is left out. Work still running without a measure draws the one loading animation (parts/ui/show/loading-mark); work with a measure fills a ring. The key is the kind a caller passes to notify(). A kind with no row here still draws with the fallback, so a caller can introduce a kind before anyone styles it. Tones name screen-look notification tones in notifications.css. A notification draws as a glance row (parts/ui/show/listing-card), whose tones are the plain tone words; `listing_tones` turns a kind's tone, or a chip's badge tone, into one of them, and a chip whose tone turns into anything but the quiet tone is the row's state badge.
